positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with senior developers to manage a large, complex design self-learning website like Cousera.
- Responsible for highly interactive pages, used React.js, d3.js and Go(Iris) to implement a dashboard page for each user to manage study plans and a search page to search study materials through the database. 
λ	Minimized average page loading time from 1s to 0.1s by using more efficient filtering and sorting algorithms when fetching data and manipulating local data.
am.

positions.title: Visualization System of New York City Traffic Flow
positions.description:
1. Implemented a full stack system for New York City Taxi Traffic Data, showing the time series of all routes between each pair of zones in new york city. 
2. Visualize data with chord graph, heat map and pie chart, etc.
2. Created a new visualizing tool for D3.js that shows time series data of different time window and allow users to compare between within one plot.

company.name: USC Viterbi Graduate and Professional Programs

positions.title: Visualization/Visual Analytics Intern
positions.description:
1. Implemented a full stack system for scalable machine log data visualization and analysis, handling data volume of >~20 million rows. 
2. Created a system that visualizes attributes’ correlations of high-dimensional data in different levels of abstraction, allowing users to analyze >~40 attributes on a 10-inch screen at one time. 
3. Developed a vehicle workshop analyze system, using PyMongo and MongoDB to wrangle raw data and for storage, using python to train data and get a series of pattern of vehicle faults, helping users to find relations between each fault and do prediction. 
4. Implemented algorithms for auto-labeling & overlap removal, reducing 98% of overlap  
5. Technologies: JavaScript, Python, d3.js, Flask, SVG, HTML, SCSS, MongoDB, MS SQL

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Image Processing Project 
- Built an image-processing system, using OpenCV/C++ and 8 cameras as hardware, capturing panoramic images, processing all captured images, filter noise and combine them into a panoramic photo
 - Accomplishment: system can do automatic image stitching within 30ms, and produce panoramic video in real time

positions.title: student researcher
positions.description:
	Learnt to use several optical measurement methods such as knife-edge scan and z-scan
	Used Mathematica to simulate optical paths, verified the principles of z-scan 
	Participated in the COMAS project, assisted in adjusting z-scan paths and measuring nonlinear coefficients of thin films
